purpose: Document first-party local cadastral/registry evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Public Mathura Sadar selectors and map extents respond, but the WUP center’s revenue-village coverage was not resolved. A click query using Mathura Bangar’s GIS code at the exact WUP coordinate returned an empty JSON object; its map extent begins north of the WUP point. No polygon was retained.
registryAssessment: The Government of Uttar Pradesh public cadastral digitization dashboard includes Mathura district tehsils and village map counts; the official viewer provides Mathura/Sadar revenue-village selectors. This confirms a local cadastral record service.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Uttar Pradesh public BhuNaksha viewer exposes District, Tehsil, Village selection and parcel-map display. The public application has a Mathura Sadar selector route.

Government of Uttar Pradesh dashboard reports Mathura tehsil totals for scanned, verified, georeferenced and BhuNaksha-linked cadastral maps; this establishes digitized local map coverage, not citywide parcel completeness.
UP Revenue Board portal describes public land record and BhuNaksha/plot information services.

searchQueries.query: मथुरा भू नक्शा भूलेख राजस्व परिषद उत्तर प्रदेश cadastral map official
searchQueries.result: Government UP BhuNaksha viewer is public. Official dashboard shows Mathura district tehsils with digitized and georeferenced map statistics, including Mathura tehsil.
searchQueries.method: Separate Hindi-language search followed by public official viewer and district dashboard inspection.
searchQueries.scope: Find official Mathura cadastral map viewer, local revenue selectors and digitization status.

searchQueries.query: Mathura cadastral parcel map public GIS BhuNaksha Uttar Pradesh official
searchQueries.result: The official UP viewer serves public parcel maps with district, tehsil, revenue-village and plot selectors. Mathura Sadar village extents are available in EPSG:32644. The WUP point was outside the tested Mathura Bangar extent; a click query there returned an empty JSON object, so no polygon sample was retained.
searchQueries.method: Separate English-language search and safe read-only requests to public selectors/extent/click-query endpoints. No owner, khata holder, address, or plot-info endpoint queried.
searchQueries.scope: Cross-check anonymous geometry access, native IDs and local point coverage.

geometryDecision: No complete full polygon with a safely validated native parcel identifier was retained. The public viewer advertises/displays parcel geometry, but an exact WUP-point sample was not verified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Public BhuNaksha map service covers selected Uttar Pradesh revenue villages; the Mathura district dashboard reports digitized and georeferenced cadastral maps for district tehsils.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The anonymous viewer exposes public district/tehsil/village selectors, Mathura Sadar village extent metadata in EPSG:32644, and a map click-query route. Exact WUP-point map coverage remains unresolved; no complete polygon sample or citywide completeness is claimed.

attempts.observation: Public administrative selector levels are District, Tehsil and Village.

Extent response for Mathura Bangar: EPSG:32644, x 169164.067–173469.145, y 3043181.933–3048388.613. Transformed WUP center (171226.77, 3041369.09) lies south of this map extent.

attempts.observation: Returned an empty JSON object; no parcel ID or geometry was returned. Owner/plot-info endpoints were not queried.

remainingUncertainty: Which Sadar revenue-village map covers the WUP population-weighted point; map extent rectangles do not establish parcel containment. The public viewer displays cadastral parcels, but a complete native feature response at the exact city point was not obtained.
